quote.translation: That "this clover" is "four-leaved" must have some cause, whether its state of nourishment, the influence of the climate, the stimulus of an injury or something else.

regions.text: 等かの原因がなくてはならぬ。二頭一身の蛇といふやうなものが極めて稀れな偶然存在であることは誰しも認める。

quote.translation: Everyone accepts that a snake with two heads on one body is an extremely rare and contingent existence.

regions.text: 然しながら、生物學者の實驗によれば、手術によつて人工的に二頭一身の蛇を造ることが出来るから、自然界に見られる二頭一身の蛇の如きも極く若いうちに頭都が二つに切れたために生じたものと考へられてゐる。

quote.translation: Yet biologists' experiments have shown that a two-headed snake can be produced artificially by surgery, and so it is thought that the two-headed snakes found in nature arise because the head was split in two at a very early stage.

regions.text: 二頭一身の蛇を偶然前と考へるのは蛇といふ一般機念に開聯させて見る限りにおいてである。

quote.translation: We regard the two-headed snake as contingent only insofar as we see it in relation to the general concept of the snake; that "this" snake has two heads must have some cause.

regions.text: 「この蛇が二頭を有つてゐるには何等かの原因がなくてはならぬ。生來の不具者や自痴などを偶然所と考へるのも「人間といふ一般概念との開聯においてである。「この「不具者、「かの」白痴にはそれぞれの發生學的其他の原因がなくてはならぬ。

quote.translation: When we regard those born with disabilities, or those with severe intellectual disability, as contingent, it is likewise in relation to the general concept "human", while "this" disabled person and "that" person must each have embryological or other causes.

regions.text: 外貌の「端正醸悪」を偶然約と考へるのも。「人間といぶ一般概念を立ててその一般概念との關係において特殊を目整するからである。「この「人が「端正」であり、「かの「入が「醸悪であるのには、男女雨性の生殖細胞の結合の仕方か、妊娠時の母後の健康狀態か、何等かの原因がなくてばならぬ。

quote.translation: When we regard a handsome or an ugly appearance as contingent, it is because we have set up the general concept "human" and witness the particular in relation to it; that "this" person is handsome and "that" person ugly must have some cause, in the way the germ cells of the two sexes combined, in the mother's health during pregnancy, or elsewhere.

regions.text: 同様に、皮膚の色の相達による人種の差別は「人間」をいふ概念的本質にとつては偶然的のものである。

quote.translation: In the same way, racial difference by skin colour is contingent for the conceptual essence of the "human".

regions.text: しかし一つの特殊な人種を皮膚

quote.translation: But the relation between a particular race and its skin colour is in no way contingent; that "this" race has a certain skin colour must have its cause in light, temperature and other conditions.
